collector.registration: Ten exact inventory retailers and one bounded release-watch source run through independent source adapters. Three public Tupelo2Go merchant pages require exact permit premise, immutable restaurant ID, and active menu controls while proving only binary orderability. Two exact GoTo adapters remain registered but source-policy-blocked, make no autonomous requests, and stay health-visible. MS is absent from LEGACY_PRECISION_RUNTIME_STATES.

storeIdentity.proof: Every reviewed premises has a unique ms-permit-NNNNNN ID. Inventory additionally requires exact permit, merchant/store, host, product URL, premises, city, ZIP, orderability, and sourceRuntimeId bindings.

sourceSemantics.directory: Exactly 690 current Package Retailer permits across 168 cities and 78 counties; searchable identity only.
sourceSemantics.officialIntelligence: DOR catalog, SPA, pricing, bailment, wholesale, and policy documents are intelligence only and never bottle inventory.
sourceSemantics.availability: Ten exact storefronts are monitored for binary local orderability, including three exact public Tupelo2Go merchant pages, and Mabry's bounded first-party surface contributes non-inventory release-watch evidence. The immutable pre-expansion baseline produced fresh exact-store rows from four stores across two reviewed regions. Inventory quantity is 0 and quantityIsExact is false; marketplace controls do not prove counts, pickup, delivery, or guaranteed fulfillment; release-watch rows cannot imply shelf count or fulfillment.

coverage.assertion: Coverage exposes Mississippi exact-store inventory with 690 known stores, ten inventory sources plus one non-inventory release-watch source, a four-store immutable production baseline, three bounded preproduction-validated Tupelo merchant additions, and zero alert-grade stores.

stateFilter.assertion: Mississippi is an active sparse state and is available in state-scoped customer surfaces.

areaFilter.assertion: The canonical nine-region alias registry powers exact engine and shared website matching without substring bleed.

preferences.assertion: Mississippi may be selected for on-site coverage while outbound inventory and watch alerts remain disabled.

dashboard.assertion: Fresh exact-store Mississippi rows may appear on-site with sparse and verify-before-driving language.

dropFeedApi.assertion: The Drop Feed may expose current exact-store Mississippi orderability rows; directory-only, official-intelligence, stale, aggregate, and blocked-source rows remain excluded.

finder.reason: The full permit directory remains research data and is not exported as live inventory.

alerts.assertion: Lifecycle, central confidence, activation baseline, retailer policy, and release policy keep email, SMS, and outbound delivery false.

monitoring.assertion: Thirteen independent retailer runtime IDs and blocked/offline/probe-only BottleCapps entries remain represented in source health.

export.assertion: Only fresh exact-store rows that pass the Mississippi retailer policy may enter the active on-site snapshot.

shadow.assertion: Three successful immutable GitHub Actions shadow runs spanning more than 24 hours produced safe exact-store rows from four stores across two reviewed regions with no delivery attempts or production publication.

canary.assertion: Two isolated non-deploying canary previews rendered the current Mississippi on-site drop with zero alert rows, delivery disabled, production snapshot publication disabled, and production deployment disabled.

production.assertion: Production activation is permitted only after guarded merge, targeted refresh, and exact-store verification confirm at least four live stores and zero alert-grade outbound rows.
